rules.statement: In a will disposing of property, if the testator intends to create a fidei commissum and clearly defines the class of beneficiaries, the court should interpret the will according to its natural meaning unless it leads to an absurd result.
rules.supporting_quote: "Their Lordships cannot so construe the wording of this will. It is plainly indicated that Pitchammal is to enjoy the income and its subsequent devolution is carefully provided for."

meta.parties: Meera Saibo Ahamado Nordeen v. Meera Saibo Mohamed Badurdeen
